item.title: Residents of Spanish Towns Caught in Fierce Blazes Recount Harrowing Escapes
item.description:
Inferno in the Countryside

A wave of unrelenting flames swept through the Spanish towns of Vitoria and Bilbao, leaving a trail of devastation in its wake and claiming the lives of 12 residents. Those who escaped recount harrowing tales of chaos, confusion, and desperation as they fought for their lives amidst the inferno.

The disaster unfolded with alarming speed, catching residents off guard as the flames tore through the landscape with little warning. “It was like a horror movie,” said Maria Rodriguez, a local resident who managed to escape the blaze with her family. “We were told there was a fire, but nobody knew where it was or how big it was. We were left to fend for ourselves, trying to get out of there as fast as we could.” Rodriguez’s account is echoed by many others who were forced to flee for their lives as the fire raged on.
